blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) on Wednesday said it imposed a two-year revocation of the driver’s license of an actor who was involved in an accident along Marcos Highway, Antipolo City, Rizal. The actor reportedly lost control of the vehicle after he experienced severe fatigue, which led to him crashing into three establishments, according to the agency. It did not name the actor involved in the incident.
